We need answer multiple choice Chinese junior high politics. Need analyze. Question: 2018 private enterprise symposium, President emphasized private economy can only be strengthened, cannot be weakened. Why? Options:
A. 民营经济是国民经济的主导力量
B. 民营经济是社会主义经济制度的基础
C. 只有民营经济才能促进大众创业、万众创新
D. 我国坚持以公有制为主体、多种所有制经济共同发展

Need select correct. In China political economics: 国有经济 is leading force (主导力量), not private economy. Public ownership is foundation (基础) of socialist economic system, not private. "只有民营经济才能" is too absolute, false. D: basic economic system public ownership dominant, diverse ownership develop together; includes non-public economy (private economy) important component. So reason private economy can only be strengthened because our basic economic system includes multiple ownership developing together; state supports encourages guides non-public economy. D is correct. Need final line exactly 答案：D.
Need maybe include brief explanation? User asks answer. Desired format last line. Could include explanation and final. Ensure final line. In Chinese.
content:
解析：
A 错误，国民经济的主导力量是国有经济，不是民营经济。  
B 错误，社会主义经济制度的基础是公有制经济，不是民营经济。  
C 表述过于绝对，“只有民营经济才能促进大众创业、万众创新”不符合我国基本经济制度。  
D 正确，我国坚持以公有制为主体、多种所有制经济共同发展，民营经济作为非公有制经济的重要组成部分，只能壮大、不能弱化。

答案：D
